decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from colinhacks/zod PR #6441, merged 2026-08-19, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. zod v4's string length checks measured input.length (UTF-16 code units), double-counting astral characters. The fix spans three core files (system complexity): util.ts adds a codePointLength helper, checks.ts rewires $ZodCheckMaxLength/MinLength/LengthEquals with a bounded fast path (a code point is 1-2 units, so the exact count is computed only when the unit count leaves the verdict in doubt), and compile.ts threads the same logic through the compiled validator codegen. Semantics are code points, not graphemes: combining marks and ZWJ sequences still count as several. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (060bc9f3) to packages/zod plus root LICENSE/package.json (same slicing as the prior zod task; hidden tests import ./packages/zod/src/v4 directly via tsx, no install). Coverage: 6 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — min/max/length with astral emoji, combining-mark and ZWJ code-point counts, and the COMPILED path for max and length (a fix that only touches checks.ts fails those two); 5 pass_to_pass guards pin ASCII bounds, array element counting, nonempty, compiled ASCII behavior, and that error issues keep reporting the declared bound. Assertions check safeParse success and issue fields via public APIs, never message text. Expected values come from the upstream PR's own test cases.
